acceptances.reason: GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv in extract-zip: unvalidated symlink path traversal when unpacking an archive. Reached only through the Lighthouse and size-limit toolchain, which uses it to unpack a Chrome build downloaded from Google over TLS during a performance run. No archive here is attacker-supplied, and none of these packages ship in the application bundle. The advisory range is "*" — upstream has no patched release, and the only fix npm proposes is a major downgrade of @lhci/cli, which would take the performance gate below the version its evidence format depends on. Re-review when extract-zip publishes a fix or @puppeteer/browsers drops it.
